svg.title: QAD training architecture: teacher-student knowledge distillation for quantized ASR
svg.desc: Left: Teacher 1.7B FP16, all frozen. Right: Student 0.6B INT4, audio tower and LM head frozen, decoder trainable. Both receive the same unlabeled audio. Their logits feed a combined KL plus CE loss computed on response tokens only. Gradients backpropagate exclusively to the student decoder.
